description: List the extra data packages that can be loaded onto a travel eSIM this wallet already bought, so it keeps working instead of being replaced. Pass the order_id from purchase_esim and the ak_live_ key. The offer is per eSIM and live, so call this rather than reusing codes from search_esim_plans - those are for NEW eSIMs and will not work here. Read-only: it spends nothing.

api_key.description: The ak_live_ key returned by create_wallet. Pass it here, or as an Authorization: Bearer header.

order_id.description: The order_id of the travel eSIM to reload, from purchase_esim.

name: list_esim_topups
